title: Any ideas for work from home?

posts.body:
Hi everyone, new to the site.
Came across this forum while looking for home work ideas.
I'm happy to be a stay at home mum but would like to feel like I'm contributing towards the bills a little!
I've done ebay and I'm not wanting to try and make a living out of that, I only ever sold stuff that I no longer wanted instead of finding a product that I could keep on selling.
Has anyone found any work from home companies that are not scams, don't require you to trudge the streets and that actually brings in a little money?  I'm not looking for get rich quick schemes, just want to see a few more pennies coming in rather than watching them go out all the time!
Any advice would be great!

Hi Helen,
Have you thought of party plan?
I used to be a Kleeneze distributor but decided to try party plan so that at least I would be in a nice warm house while I'm working 🙂 There are loads to choose from and I would advise you to think about the products you love working with to help you make your choice. I have tried many and have settled on one that makes me feel really good 🙂 I absolutely love pampering women and making them feel good and that helped me to choose the party plan company that I am currently involved in along with the fact that they help farmers in third world countries as well as the UK to receive a fair wage. The company I work with also works really hard to raise awareness and funds for Children on the Edge which appealed to me greatly.
I work with bodyshop and earn extra money as well as some lovely free products for myself 😀
If this appeals to you just reply to me and I'll help you with whatever I can 🙂
Take care,
Jenny 🙂
did you find a good business to do at home?

Hello, I know your post is some years now but I just wonder if you found any business working from home yet ?
Thanks

Hi I'm not sure if you have found anything yet, but I have recently started a new online business.  It is from a company that has had massive success in the USA and is now coming over to the UK.  They are still in pre-launch but people are already making money from it (45,000 new customers in the last 3 months in the UK alone).
Feel free to contact me for anymore information.
Good luck in whatever you chose to do.

You can start working on various online sites. If you are good at writing then you can try Hubpages or Blogjob. If you are willing to take risks then you may try revshare sites like Traffic Monsoon or My Paying Ads. You can also sign up for Fiverr and offer your services there. You can find freelancing projects at sites like Freelancer.

Hi Helen,
I am a younique presenter, i was really skeptical and didn't believe that i would make any money with there been a £69 outlay for my presenter kit which is beautiful, however i have earned nearly £200 in a month just selling make up through Facebook and from word of mouth.
Its an amazing support group as well, as every purchase from the Younique foundation they donate 50% of the profits to women in domestic abuse relationships.
If you would like anymore information on what you get in your presenter pack or what the pay/commission is like give me a message.
If you decide this is not for you, i wish you the best in whatever you do.
Fay xxxx

I am trying to do the same thing by finding a work at home business or other online income. I do sell on eBay and have thought about doing it as a business. I am also an independent Avon Representative and I am liking it so far. I am trying to get my online website marketed so I can do most of the selling online. I like the people that I work with and they are very supportive and have tons of advice for those just starting out. Hope you find or have found what you are looking for.

What are your interests? Are you thinking of starting a new business? You can do online selling and engaged your business in all social media feeds. If you are interested working with a company, you can try applying at odesk.com and you will find a lot of good opportunities there for a stay at home parent.
Start re-selling something on Ebay and Amazon

Now it is very relevant, so I will share what I did myself. Writing texts, running a social networking page, selling products, or being an online manager. Usually it doesn't take much time and you have the opportunity to be with your family.
